description: E2 (decision E2-4): the preparation, optional. Ysolde tells of the Ash-pit, the herders' tarn drained through the Cut when the Titan's heat came, and of the Grey Spur over the Cut that no men could move: heave it over (only a stage-9 giant can) and it dams the Cut, the springs fill the pit 6.5 m deep (world.ashfell.dammed) - water the Titan, lured into it, goes down on a knee in. Optional XP only (not on the guaranteed path).

stages.objective: Heave the Grey Spur down into the Cut, so the Ash-pit fills again
stages.waiting_text: The Grey Spur leans over the Cut at the Ember Hollow's west end. Only a stage-9 giant can heave it over.
